literal_source_claim: 解析博弈的决定性 (determinacy of analytic games)
provisional_candidate_claim: Every length-omega Gale-Stewart game on natural numbers whose payoff is an analytic subset of Baire space is determined.
domain_and_universes: Provisional only: plays Nat -> Nat, finite histories List Nat, and analytic payoff subsets of Baire space in Type 0. The source must fix coding and foundation.
conclusion: Open: the source must specify whether analytic determinacy is unconditional in an ambient theory or derived from an explicit large-cardinal or determinacy hypothesis.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Borel, open, closed, clopen, finite-horizon, projective, or assumed-determined games are not substitutes. A theorem with analytic determinacy as a premise is not a proof of analytic determinacy. Cantor-space and tree/projection encodings require checked transports.
scope_nodes: AD-ROOT every source-specified analytic payoff game is determined
AD-GAME infinite alternating perfect-information game semantics
AD-ANALYTIC analytic payoff representation and Baire-space topology
AD-STRATEGY player strategies, compatible plays, and winning predicates
AD-FOUNDATION exact ambient theory and any large-cardinal or determinacy premise
AD-COMPOSITION source proof architecture, deferred to source audit
foundation_profile: Open and root-critical: analytic determinacy is sensitive to the ambient set theory and consistency strength; Lean classical logic or choice must not silently replace the source's set-theoretic assumptions.
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports, encoding, declaration closure, and axiom profile remain open.
computation_profile: No computation, oracle, experiment, or unchecked certificate is credited; noncomputable strategy existence is expected.
formal_system: Lean 4 plus pinned mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source selection, canonical wording, game/payoff coding, analytic pointclass convention, foundation assumptions, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, assurance profile, or validator change; independent reviewers and review due date remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. Pinned Lean descriptive-set-theory ingredients elaborate, but no exact primary-source theorem, foundation profile, or canonical Lean target is accepted. No H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
